chapter.title: Boards
chapter.para: JetOS runs on two boards, both emulated by QEMU: x86_64-qemu, the PC machine, and arm64-qemu, the virt machine. The requirements are those that the kernel has of a board.

section.title: SRQ_JET_BSP_001
section.para: A board shall provide to the kernel: the main console and optionally the debug console, the interrupt controller with the interrupt of a periodic timer, the system time, the calendar time, a means to stop and to resume the system time, and the reset of the module.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: This is all the kernel uses of the hardware that is not the processor.

section.title: SRQ_JET_BSP_002
section.para: The board x86_64-qemu shall provide the serial lines as consoles, the two 8259 interrupt controllers with their interrupts delivered as vectors 32 to 47, the 8254 timer as the periodic timer at the configured frequency, and the system time from the time stamp counter of the processor, whose frequency is calibrated against the timer at the start.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the devices of the PC machine.

section.title: SRQ_JET_BSP_003
section.para: The board arm64-qemu shall provide the PL011 serial lines as consoles (the second one only if QEMU creates it, which the kernel finds in the device tree), the GICv2 interrupt controller, the virtual timer of the processor as the periodic timer at the configured frequency and as the system time, the PL031 real-time clock as the calendar time at the start, and the reset of the module through PSCI.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the devices of the virt machine.

section.title: SRQ_JET_BSP_004
section.para: The boards shall place the memory of the partitions 16 MiB into the RAM, below which are the kernel image and the heap of the kernel, and shall assume 1 GiB of RAM.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Both boards have the same layout, and the same memory is enough for the hypervisor.

section.title: SRQ_JET_BSP_005
section.para: The boards shall give the same behaviour to the kernel, except where the devices differ: the time sources, the interrupt controllers, the serial lines and the reset.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The kernel above the boards is the same.
